name: path-guard
description: agents ask before they change files under the folders you protect, such as /prod or /contracts.

guard_paths.description: show, add, or remove protected folders. agents cannot write, edit, move, copy, or delete inside them.

add.description: a folder to protect, such as /prod

path-guard.text: some folders are protected by the human. a write there is blocked; when it is, say so and ask the human to change it themselves or to unprotect the folder. only add or remove protected folders when the human asks.
